Name: Alchemist_DubaiChewyCookie
Author: BTypeAlchemist
Description:
[b]🍫 Detailed Description
[/b][b]Alchemist's Dubai Chewy Cookie (DUZZONCOO)[/b] adds a structured, multi-step dessert crafting experience to Stardew Valley 1.6.
Inspired by the Dubai-style pistachio chocolate dessert that became popular in Korea, this mod introduces new intermediate ingredients and a premium final dessert designed to make the crafting process feel immersive and rewarding.

🍃 Crafting ChainThis mod introduces a layered cooking progression:
• [b]Kadayif[/b] – made from Flour and Water
• [b]Pistachio Spread[/b] – crafted using Pistachios and cooking ingredients
• [b]Dubai Chewy Cookie[/b] – the final chocolate-coated dessert
The crafting flow is intentionally structured to give meaning to intermediate ingredients rather than making everything instantly consumable.

🍽 Design PhilosophyIntermediate ingredients (Kadayif and Pistachio Spread) are intentionally non-edible.
They are designed as preparation components, encouraging a proper cooking progression rather than direct consumption.
Only the final product, the Dubai Chewy Cookie, provides full food benefits.

🏪 Availability
All recipes are sold by [b]Gus at the Saloon[/b], allowing players to unlock the dessert line naturally through gameplay.

💧 Additional
ContentIncludes a drinkable bottled water item, compatible with Survivalistic-Rebooted gameplay mods.

⚙ Compatibility
• Built for Stardew Valley 1.6
• Works alongside Cornucopia (uses Pistachio and Cocoa ingredients)
• Safe for existing saves

🎯 Balance
The Dubai Chewy Cookie is positioned as a premium dessert item with balanced pricing and moderate buffs, fitting naturally into late mid-game progression.

Downloads.Description: Multi-step dessert crafting mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 featuring Kadayif, Pistachio Spread, and the Dubai Chewy Cookie. Includes Saloon-sold recipes and a drinkable bottled water item. Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Cornucopia.
